findings.finding: Directed-network intentionally slices active transfers to20 and labels first20; shared host paging alone cannot make subsequent author-omitted transfers reachable. limited-order-book passes every active order and can benefit from shared paging without script changes.

CRISPR Bacterium/Ecosystem UI projections call stats.histogram on observed sequence arrays. Do not silently move or alter biological histogram bins while implementing presentation APIs; any ownership cleanup needs exact independent fixtures.

Several triangle projections explicitly use size8, equal to the current shared canvas default. Removing redundant overrides is possible without a new API; this does not authorize replacing quantity-driven sizes or source-portrayal differences.

Office, EV and goods helpers repeat wrapping, slot dimensions and group spacing. Use canonical observed queue snapshots and separate identity from capacity; bike stores may benefit only if transit/topology remains visible.

Heat fixed min/max, directed-network sqrt relative value, fire ember decay, Mandelbrot fixed115 iterations, heatbugs declared dual normalization and other source mappings must not become silent per-frame auto normalization.
